headline: US and India Advance Bilateral Trade Agreement and Energy Cooperation Talks
summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio concluded official meetings in India with External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar, focusing on a proposed bilateral trade pact and expanded strategic energy cooperation.
why: Closer bilateral trade and energy alignment between the US and India shapes supply chain resilience and global trade flows.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Expanded bilateral trade and energy cooperation enhances trade visibility and capital access.
